div.span:
Regularized Mahalanobis Distance:
D_M(x) = sqrt( sum( ((x_i - mu_i) / (sigma_i + epsilon))^2 ) )

Standardized Behavioral Score:
s(x) = -D_M(x)
(Genuine Owner: s(x) ~ -2.5 to -3.8; Impostor: s(x) < -10.0)

5 Timing Features:
t_total, t_p1, t_p2, t_p3, delta_t_lag

4 Force Features:
f_peak, f_mean, f_integral (work), df_dt_max

5 Motion Features:
w_peak, w_integral, a_peak, a_rms, jerk_peak

Phase 1: Contact & Grip Build-up (P1)
• Force F(t) rises via Sigmoid: F_peak / (1 + exp(-k*(t - t0)))
• Gyro w(t) ~ 0; Accel a(t) ~ micro-tremor

Phase 2: Handle Rotation (P2)
• Solenoid deadbolt resistance torque
• Gyro w(t) follows Bell Curve: w_peak * exp(-((t - t_rot)/s)^2)
• Accel magnitude surges with centripetal component

Phase 3: Spring Return Rebound & Release (P3)
• Force decays exponentially; mechanical bounce lobe
• Negative angular velocity rebound; settling oscillation

Session Day Drift (S1 to S4):
• S1 (Baseline Day): driftFactor = 1.0
• S2 (+24h): driftFactor = 1.03 (fatigue)
• S3 (+7d): driftFactor = 0.96 (habituation)
• S4 (+14d): driftFactor = 1.05 (delayed recall)

Adversary Dynamics Modulation:
• Owner: Peak Force ~45 N, Duration ~1.2s, smooth bell curve
• Impostor: Arbitrary Force ~85 N, Jerky rotation, mismatched timing
• Mimicry L1: Matched duration, inconsistent angular deceleration
• Mimicry L2: Coordinated force, subtle phase lag deviation

Mulberry32 PRNG Algorithm:
a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) >>> 0
t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1)...
